accounts.title: Chart of Accounts
accounts.introDk: The chart of accounts follows the Danish Business Authority's standard chart of accounts. Each account has the standard account number (used in SAF-T) and a line in the Danish Financial Statements Act layout that the reports group by. Headings cannot be posted to. Inactive accounts can be activated when needed.

taxCodes.title: Tax Codes
taxCodes.energyTax: Energy duty (the whole amount is booked on the duty account)
taxCodes.intro: The VAT codes follow the Danish Business Authority's VAT code list (S01, K010 …), which is also used in the SAF-T export. The code decides how a line is booked: VAT account, deduction rate (e.g. 25% for restaurants and entertainment), reverse charge and box on the VAT return. The E codes are refundable energy duties.

closing.title: Period closing
closing.final: Closing is final and cannot be undone.
closing.error: The month could not be closed
closing.introDk: When a month is closed, all its entries get a sequential number per journal and year and can never be changed again (Danish Bookkeeping Act). Corrections are made with a reversal in an open month. Months close in order, and bank accounts must be reconciled at the last day of the month.

journals.title: Journals
journals.intro: Every entry lives in one journal and gets a sequential number per journal and year when the month is closed. A new bank account automatically gets its own bank journal.

vat.fileText: Do this when the return has been filed in TastSelv Erhverv. The period is then locked, so no entries can be dated in it.
vat.filedInfo: Filed {{date}} by {{by}}{{receipt}}. The period is locked; corrections are booked in an open period and filed as an amendment with the Danish Tax Agency.
vat.intro: The VAT return is calculated from the VAT accounts (output VAT, input VAT, VAT on foreign purchases and energy duties) and boxes A, B and C from the VAT codes on the entries. Post the VAT settlement, enter the amounts in TastSelv Erhverv in whole kroner, and then mark the period as filed. A filed period is locked: nothing more can be posted in it.

vat.notRegistered: The client is not VAT registered.

vat.reconHint: Booked = the movement on the VAT account in the period (excluding the settlement). "Without VAT code" are manual entries on the VAT account; they must be explainable.
vat.reportError: The VAT return could not be calculated
vat.rubrikHint: Box A: purchases from other EU countries. Box B: sales to other EU countries (B goods that are reported are also reported to the EC sales list). Box C: other supplies without VAT.
vat.settledInfo: The VAT settlement is posted ({{entry}}): the VAT accounts are cleared against the VAT settlement account. Enter the fields below in TastSelv Erhverv in whole kroner.
vat.title: VAT return

yearEnd.done: {{name}} is closed. The result {{result}} was transferred to account {{account}} (entry {{closing}}), and opening balances are posted in {{next}} ({{opening}}).
yearEnd.final: The year-end closing cannot be undone. The year is locked for all changes.
yearEnd.intro: The year can be closed when all its months are closed. The result accounts are cleared and the year's result is transferred to equity (retained earnings for companies, the year's result for sole traders) in the ÅA journal. Balance sheet balances are carried forward as opening entries to the next year (the PRIMO journal, per customer and supplier). The year is then locked and cannot be changed.
yearEnd.noYears: There are no financial years. Create the first one.
yearEnd.willTransfer: The year's result {{result}} will be transferred to account {{account}}.
